rules: status starts at 'pending' and may ONLY become 'passing' after the verify steps were actually executed and observed to pass.
Code compiling, typechecking, or looking correct is NOT sufficient to mark 'passing'.
If a verify step cannot be run, set status 'blocked' and fill 'blocked_by'. Never guess.
'deferred' means out of scope by explicit user decision. Do not implement deferred features.
Run `node scripts/features.mjs` to see the current tally. Never hand-edit the tally.
Update this file in the same change that implements the feature, not at session end.

features.description: CFO framing from Rho's own accounts: synthetic operating + treasury balances (data/accounts.json) → net burn (trailing spend − trailing cash in) → runway; per-finding runway_weeks_delta; a cash card with the treasury arithmetic (buffer months, APY as stated assumptions); a cash-in question for large unclassified inflows (customer / funding / refund) whose answer re-runs net burn. Fatigue rules: runway on alerts only when ≥ 1 week; the treasury paragraph on the first look and then only on news (shortfall, or idle cash ≥ 2 months of burn); otherwise a one-line runway status. Delivery: with 'DM to the founder' (default) all runway detail goes to the Smoke Signal app DM (unread badge) and the channel stays dollars-only with a pointer; with 'the channel' it appears inline.
verify: `cd backend && uv run pytest tests/test_cash.py`: runway/sweep arithmetic on fixed inputs (21.7 mo, $1.0M sweep, upside $3,166.67/mo), shortfall case, inflow window (three complete months before the evaluated month, settled only), a $200K wire is asked about and 'funding' removes it from cash in and is not re-asked, runway delta sign and size, renewals excluded, no accounts → no cash block.
